biggest_catch: Bonus is paid in SOL, a highly volatile crypto asset — Binance.US's own terms state 'Crypto assets are highly volatile. The value of the Bonus and of any deposit can go down as well as up, and you may lose the entire value,' and 'The Bonus is a promotional reward, not investment advice, a security offering, an income guarantee, or a promise of future value.' It is a marketing incentive, not income. You must also lock up a first deposit of at least $250, untouched, from deposit day through November 17, 2026 (about 2 months); withdrawing any part of it forfeits the bonus permanently.
catches: Bonus paid entirely in SOL; USD value of the SOL received may be higher or lower than the stated USD bonus value at crediting and afterwards due to market movement (terms Section 5.3, 8.1).
Qualifying first deposit is at least $250; one deposit only — subsequent deposits cannot combine or upgrade the tier, and the tier is fixed by that single first deposit.
30-day pre-crediting holding period through November 17, 2026: withdrawing any portion of the qualifying deposit during this window forfeits the bonus in full, even if you redeposit afterward.
Exact deposit-tier breakpoints are only shown in the promo page's tier calculator; the published figure is 'up to $200 in SOL.'
One bonus per person, household, wallet, device, IP address, and verified identity; multiple accounts disqualify all bonuses.
US-only, only in states where Binance.US operates; 18+; must clear KYC; new/first-time depositors only.
Binance.US may amend, suspend, or terminate the promotion at any time; decisions on eligibility and abuse are final.
Promotion period: September 17, 2026 at 3:00 PM ET through October 17, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET.

steps: Visit the official promo landing page promo.binance.us/sol and enter your email address, then click 'Enroll & Deposit here'.
Create your Binance.US account at binance.us/register using the SAME email address you entered on the landing page, and complete identity verification (KYC).
Make a qualifying first deposit of at least $250 (cash or crypto) by October 17, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET — this single deposit locks in your bonus tier.
Keep the entire qualifying deposit in your account untouched from deposit day through November 17, 2026 (withdrawing any portion forfeits the bonus).
Receive the SOL bonus (up to $200 in SOL, tiered by deposit size) credited to your account within 30 business days after the holding period (distributed no later than December 18, 2026).
timing: Rewards distributed no later than December 18, 2026; official terms state the bonus is credited within 30 business days of the end of the holding period (holding period runs through November 17, 2026).
